corpora.name: Titanic passenger records with the lifeboat and body fields
corpora.licence: Public (as recorded in the OpenML metadata of dataset 40945, version 1)
corpora.notes: Frozen extract of OpenML dataset 40945 (1309 rows) at tests/fixtures/titanic_extract.csv with the columns survived, pclass, sex, age, sibsp, parch, fare, embarked, boat and body; names, tickets, cabins and home destinations are dropped. The sha256 is that of the CSV, not of the ARFF at source_url. Used by tests/unit/test_titanic_extract.py. Stays candidate (licence to be verified by a person): the file has no defect labels (ground_truth_file, adjudication_source), and the licence line is the OpenML metadata, not a legal check.
